title: Keto Treacle Caramel Temptation
description: A low-carb dessert recipe combining the sweetness of treacle with the richness of keto-friendly caramel.

ingredients.name: Keto-Friendly Chocolate Chips (at least 85% cocoa)
ingredients.notes: Melts well for a smooth caramel

instructions: 1. Line a small saucepan with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
2. Combine treacle, heavy cream, almond milk, granulated sweetener, and butter in a medium saucepan.
3. Place the saucepan over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until the mixture reaches 235°F (118°C) on a candy thermometer.
4. Remove the saucepan from the heat and carefully pour in the keto-friendly chocolate chips.
5. Let the mixture sit for 1-2 minutes before stirring until the chocolate is fully melted and the caramel is smooth.
6. Stir in the vanilla extract, if using.
7. Pour the caramel mixture onto the prepared saucepan and let it cool and set at room temperature.
8. Once set, break the caramel into small pieces and serve immediately.
